Total structural destruction, scouring, foundation undermining, zero vertical survival

rishi_ganga_validation_exposure.comment: In the steep Chamoli canyon, OpenStreetMap only contained 56 buildings (mostly Raini village school and temple). Google Open Buildings V3 identified 362 remote structures including NTPC Tapovan Vishnugad workers' dormitories, barrages, aggregate crushing plants, and hillside livestock pens that were wiped out in the Feb 2021 disaster.
